# Victorian Cancer Screening Statistical Report

The Victorian Cancer Screening Statistical Report describes screening numbers and participation or coverage rates in Victoria for the three population cancer screening programs: the National Bowel Cancer Screening Program, BreastScreen Victoria and the National Cervical Screening Program. It also covers HPV self-collection and time to assessment for bowel and cervical screening.

The report presents data by age, sex and location to show where to focus efforts to increase screening participation.

## About this site

This is a **training demo**. It recreates the layout of the [ACPCC's Victorian Cancer Screening Statistical Report](https://report.acpcc.org.au/) using Quarto and R, so analysts can practise Git and GitHub on a realistic project. Every number is generated by `data-raw/make-synthetic.R`. None of it describes real people or real screening results.
:::
